notes.title: Loyalty discount back up again!
notes.content: Steam-owners of the base game Armada 2526 can now get Armada 2526 Gold against a very nice loyalty discount. The offer runs until July 1st 2013. Owners of Armada 2526 must login to Steam and check the Armada 2526 Gold store page for details. If you make this purchase it adds the Supernova expansion to your base game, effectively upgrading it to Armada 2526 Gold.

notes.title: Now Available - Armada 2526
notes.content:
Armada 2526 is now available on Steam and is 10% off for the first week to celebrate it's release!

Armada 2526 is a strategy game where you guide one of 12 races on their first interstellar journey from a single planet, until it becomes a mighty pan-galactic empire.

10% off ends April 15th, 10am Pacific Time.
